name: Grizzly Creek Classic Grilled American Cheese on Sourdough
whyItWorks: Melted American cheese griddled between two slices of white or sourdough bread provides gentle carbohydrates and warm comfort food in Camp Snoopy without fried batter, raw greens, or spicy seasoning.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the grilled cheese lightly griddled. Ask to swap french fries for a fruit cup or applesauce pouch.
